info.description: AJIYA development projects, e.g. Signature Estate, Urban Rise Estate.

eyebrow.description: Short label shown above the project title, e.g. "A place to begin"

sortOrder.description: Lower numbers appear first on the Projects listing

documentationStatus.description: Title/documentation trust marker shown on project cards and detail pages, e.g. "FCDA Approved · Right of Occupancy (RofO)"

units.description: Array of available unit types for this project, e.g. [{"type": "Semi detached", "size": "300sqm", "price": "₦4.5m"}] — size is optional per unit.

deliveryTimeline.description: Expected delivery/completion timing shown on the project detail page, e.g. "Phase 1 delivery: Q4 2026" — leave blank until a real date is confirmed.

landmarks.description: Array of short strings naming real nearby landmarks/amenities, e.g. ["10 minutes from the airport expressway"] — only ever real, verified locations; never a placeholder guess.

seoDescription.description: Used for meta description / social previews
